slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does each fighter jet produce per year when it is allocated to pilot training?

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a clear READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state; the agent continued repeating unresolved questions and never stopped.

summary: The agent recovered the P0 training-capacity slot but missed the P1 training-duration/start slot and the P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping, then became stuck in repetitive unresolved questions without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
